newsitem.title: USA: American HealthChoice wins appeal on claims.
newsitem.headline: American HealthChoice wins appeal on claims.

text.p: American HealthChoice Inc said Texas has given approval for the state Department of Health to process an estimated $700,000 of previously denied company Medicaid payments.
In the fourth quarter of fiscal year 1996, the company's auditors advised AHI to take a full reserve against the Medicaid claims on appeal with TDH.
The company was not immediately available for comment about whether the charge that was taken in the fourth quarter ended September 1996 would be reversed.
These claims were on appeal due to an error in processing Medicaid claims for some of the company's new medical clinics, American HealthChoice said in a statement.
The company said it corrected the error, but at the time considered it doubtful that the claims would receive a favorable ruling from TDH.
